function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {

    const filters = [];

    console.log('========== BUILD ROOM FILTER ==========');
    console.log('select_unit:', api.state.select_unit);
    console.log('select_building:', api.state.select_building);
    console.log('select_floor:', api.state.select_floor);

    if (api.state.select_unit) {
        filters.push('unidade=' + api.state.select_unit);
    }

    if (api.state.select_building) {
        filters.push('predio=' + api.state.select_building);
    }

    if (api.state.select_floor) {
        filters.push('andar=' + api.state.select_floor);
    }

    filters.push('ativo_para_reserva=true');

    const filtroFinal = filters.join('^');

    console.log('FILTRO FINAL:', filtroFinal);

    api.setState('room_filter', filtroFinal);
